body: Vistula Cloud is hiring a DevOps Engineer in Krakow. You will run EKS clusters with Helm and Argo CD, keep Terraform modules for AWS tidy, and improve our GitLab CI pipelines. We use Prometheus and Grafana for monitoring and GitHub Actions for some open source repositories. Istio experience is a plus. Written for Alex Example test runs only.
Specific details: run EKS clusters with Helm ; improve our GitLab CI pipelines
